diagnostic.proxy_limitation: grasp is inferred from robosuite contact geoms via inner._check_grasp, a contact-based proxy, not a tactile/force measurement; it can be wrong at contact transitions and is unknown when the probe is unavailable. Unknown grasp or velocity is never treated as success.

raw_trial.first_grasp_confirmed_step_note: first_grasp_confirmed_step is the shadow guard MONITOR's own confirmation step only. The monitor latches failed_grasp, so this field may stay null even when later shadow actions truly lift and grasp the bottle; a null value must never be read as 'never grasped'. The independent, monitor-blind statistic is raw_stable_grasp_first_step.

raw_stable_grasp.raw_stable_grasp_limitation: raw_stable_grasp_first_step is an independent statistic computed ONLY from the shadow observer's actual raw probe telemetry (objects['wine_bottle_1'].position/grasped): the step of the fifth of 5 consecutive known samples whose wine z is at least 0.02 m above the initial probe's z while the probe reports grasped=True. It never consults the guard monitor's stage or first_grasp_confirmed_step, so it can confirm a stable grasp even after the monitor has latched failed_grasp; an unknown value is never a grasp.

limitations.assistant_preparation: branch B runs the accepted assistant open-loop preparation (0 VLA actions) after the recorded bowl prefix; it is not a learned VLA skill
limitations.recorded_policy_replay: the 102-action bowl prefix is the preserved recorded-policy replay, not a freshly generated VLA bowl execution, a recovery or a forced release
limitations.one_starting_state: one actual starting state at two model seeds is not a statistical reliability claim and no success rate is inferred
limitations.joint_configuration: the end-effector start-pose target is a measured XYZ/orientation and does NOT guarantee the full robot joint configuration
limitations.no_repair: no assessment, repair, retry, forced release or Hermes call is performed
limitations.preparation_changes: Preparation changes end-effector position/orientation, gripper opening, robot velocities and elapsed simulation time. This A/B estimates the preparation procedure effect, not an isolated position-only or orientation-only causal effect. Objects are protected by the fixed displacement gate.

aggregate.reliability_note: explicit counts only; one starting state at two model seeds is not a statistical reliability claim and no success rate is inferred
